name: DWH Content Projection Profile
purpose: provide one canonical content declaration for WebEngine runtime provider resolution

data.content: inline payload or provider-relative resource identity

rules: symbol domain/id must match returned record identity
WebEngine must not invent fallback canonical content
provider execution does not transfer content authority to WebEngine
content placement relations are DWH authority and are not encoded into the content record
dynamic #CONTENT symbols resolve through ProjectionEngine pattern dispatch

implementation.sourceAdapterRule: storage map is implementation data; semantic identity is the #CONTENT symbol and canonical DWH relations
